gloss: report to the throne; memorial to the emperor

definitions.gloss: report to the throne; memorial to the emperor
definitions.explanation: A formal report or petition submitted to the emperor by a minister or official. A historical and legal term, used mainly of the imperial court and of government under the Meiji Constitution; it does not describe reporting to an ordinary superior.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{天皇|てんのう}→天皇：04546_tennou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{上奏|じょうそう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The minister submitted a report to the emperor.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{案|あん}→案：01776_an⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{上奏|じょうそう}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧⟦されなかった→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The proposal was submitted to the throne, but it was not adopted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明治|めいじ}→明治：19860_meiji⟧⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧もと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{内閣|ないかく}→内閣：04800_naikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦{事項|じこう}→事項：11469_jikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{上奏|じょうそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{仕組|しく}み→仕組み：07168_shikumi⟧になっていた。
examples.english: Under the Meiji Constitution, the cabinet was structured so as to report important matters to the throne.

notes:
⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧ (upward) + {奏|そう} (to report to a superior). Used as a noun and with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上奏|じょうそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to report to the throne
- {上奏文|じょうそうぶん}: a written memorial to the emperor
- {上奏|じょうそう}{権|けん}: the right to report directly to the emperor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{奏上|そうじょう}→奏上：30670_soujou⟧: the same act, with the characters reversed; interchangeable in most contexts
- ⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧: report — the everyday word, used for any superior or audience
